title: respx: support httpx 0.28
notes: Test requirements from the repository's noxfile; coverage is off (--no-cov) because a subset run cannot meet its 100% gate.

title: pydantic-yaml: support pydantic 2
notes: The requirement (pydantic>=1.8) already admits 2.0; the pre-upgrade lock is held below 2. Upstream supports both majors by checking pydantic.version.VERSION. Python 3.11: pydantic 1.10.11 (July 2023) has no 3.12 wheels. Deprecation warnings are errors: upstream's change moved the code off pydantic's deprecated v1 API (parse_obj_as, .json()), which pydantic 2 still accepts with a warning.

title: click-repl: compatibility with click 8.2+
notes: Test requirements from the testing extra; pyproject's addopts turn coverage on, so it is turned off (--no-cov).

title: Flask-SQLAlchemy: compatibility with SQLAlchemy 2
notes: Upstream adapted the code during SQLAlchemy 2.0's beta and left the requirement (SQLAlchemy>=1.4.18) as it was; resolved as of 2023-01-30, after 2.0 final, with the pre-upgrade lock held below 2. Python 3.11: SQLAlchemy 1.4.46 has no 3.12 wheels. C is the merge of PR #1123; the base is its first parent.

title: emcee: updates for NumPy 2
notes: Upstream's NumPy 2 work spans four commits (b68933df3..9c5f59b6c: the update for NumPy 2 and a compatibility fix); the requirement already admits 2, so the pre-upgrade lock is held below 2. The tests live inside the package (src/emcee/tests), which is not editable. The version comes from setuptools-scm, given without git history. The spec is setup.py's INSTALL_REQUIRES. Resolved as of 2024-07-01: upstream's commits came before NumPy 2.0's release (2024-06-16). src/emcee/emcee_version.py, which setuptools-scm writes at install, is written at checkout.

title: Flask-RESTX: support Flask 3 and Werkzeug 3
notes: Upstream's Flask 3 / Werkzeug 3 support spans six commits up to the 1.3.0 release (3ea4ce196..0c441149e); setup.py reads the requirements from requirements/install.pip, the spec. Test requirements from requirements/test.pip. Licence: BSD-3-Clause (GitHub does not classify it).

title: ffn: fixes for pandas 3
notes: The requirement (pandas>=0.19) already admits 3; the pre-upgrade lock is held below 3.

title: geojson-pydantic: migrate to pydantic 2
notes: Upstream's spec moves pydantic~=1.0 to ~=2.0, so the requirement must exclude 1.x. Test requirements from the test extra. Python 3.11: pydantic 1.10.11 (July 2023) has no 3.12 wheels.

title: flask-marshmallow: support marshmallow 4
notes: Upstream made the code work with marshmallow 4 before 4.0 shipped (2025-04-16) and kept the requirement (marshmallow>=3.0.0); resolved as of 2025-04-20 with the pre-upgrade lock held below 4. Test requirements from the tests and sqlalchemy extras.
